rules: Only flip passes to true after ALL 4 Verification Gates (Build, DB/RLS, Playwright Mobile+Desktop, Fresh Diff Audit) succeed.

features.name: Next.js App Router + Tailwind + shadcn/ui + Responsive Shell (Desktop Sidebar + 390px Mobile Bottom Bar)
Apply 001_init.sql & seed.sql (9 tables, non-recursive RLS, CHECK constraints, indexes, ASSDI courses/venues/gear)
Verify DB constraints block coordinator without course_id and block cross-course SELECT via RLS
Supabase Auth (@supabase/ssr) Login + Role-Guard Middleware redirecting Admin/Coordinator/Staff/Intern
Admin User Management (/admin/users) using server-only service_role API; public self-signup disabled
Course Coordinator Requisition Form (/coordinator/new) with all 9+ courses, program types, framing, venue, call time, phone
3-day (routine) / 7-day (major event) Lead-Time Rule enforced in BOTH Zod & PostgreSQL Trigger (verified via direct supabase-js bypass test)
Admin-only Emergency Override (with mandatory reason) & Requisition Rejection with mandatory rejection_reason shown to Coordinator
Gear Master Inventory (/admin/gear) with serial numbers, Available/In Use/Maintenance status, Check-Out & Return Condition Check-In
PostgreSQL EXCLUDE USING gist Double-Booking Lock verified via concurrent Promise.all() booking test
Atomic Requisition Approval + 2-3 Member Team & Gear Assignment creating 6-stage Task Board card
Central Task Board (Pending -> Shoot Assigned -> Shoot Done -> Editing -> Review -> Completed) with deadline countdown & Google Drive URL
Coordinator 4-status mapping (Pending/Approved/Shoot Done/Delivered + Drive Link) & Staff Project Lead task stage update
Automated Shoot Assignment Slip (Team, Phones, Venue, Call Time, Gear List) with 1-click Print/PDF & wa.me WhatsApp share
Master Calendar (/admin/calendar) with Tomorrow, Next 3 Days & Next 7 Days chronological shoot schedule
Permanent Staff Daily Worklog (/staff/daily-log) with 5 categories, hours & summary
Intern Mobile-First Daily Worklog (/intern/daily-log) with hours, indoor/outdoor, raw footage auto-sync to task card & LocalStorage draft
Work History & Analytics Reports (/admin/reports) with Name/Role/Date filters, completed count, field/edit hours, deadline % & CSV export
Full 4-Role Playwright E2E Suite (390px mobile + 1280px desktop, 0 console errors), weekly pg_dump backup template & Vercel production build
